fields.options:
Selected
Processing
Stamped
Ticketed
Departed
Cancelled

fields.description: Copied from the owning Applicant's cycle_number at creation time (before_insert) -- lets 'show me everything belonging to cycle 2' be a direct filter.
fields.label: Cycle Number

fields.description: Extracted at parse time from the contract itself (Part A.4) — not the Placement's creation date. Falls back to manual entry if parsing can't find it.
fields.label: Contract Signed Date

fields.description: Saudi (Musaned-style) contracts only.
fields.label: Contract Number

fields.description: Saudi: parsed from the contract itself. Kuwait: parsed from the separately-uploaded visa document instead (see visa_number is not duplicated — Kuwait's own visa_number lives under the Visa section below via visa_reference_number/visa_type; this field is Saudi-only).
fields.label: Visa Number (Saudi)

fields.description: Saudi only — Kuwait contracts don't carry a national ID field.
fields.label: Employer National ID

fields.description: Saudi Recruiting Agency name, as printed on the contract — used to auto-match against an existing Contractor record.
fields.label: Saudi Agency Name

fields.description: Kuwait contracts only ("Employment site" / city, e.g. Kaifan).
fields.label: Employment Site (Kuwait)

fields.description: Kuwait contracts only, e.g. "two years".
fields.label: Contract Duration (Kuwait)

fields.description: The contract's own negotiated wage (Saudi: SAR, Kuwait: KD) — distinct from the Applicant's CV-stage expected salary.
fields.label: Contract Salary Amount
Contract Salary Currency
fields.options:
SAR
KWD
USD
ETB
AED
QAR

fields.description: Kuwait only — a separate document, uploaded alongside the contract. Saudi's visa data is already on the contract itself (see contract_number/visa_number above).
fields.label: Visa (Kuwait)

fields.description: Saudi: from the contract's own dates. Kuwait: from the visa document. Drives the frontend's "remaining days" display — absent if never captured.
fields.label: Visa Expiry Date

fields.description: The Kuwaiti employer/sponsor (Kafeel) named on the visa — more precise than the contract's bare phone number.
fields.label: Sponsor (Kafeel) Name

fields.description: Cross-checked against this Placement's own Contractor once the visa is uploaded — a mismatch is flagged (notify), never auto-reassigned.
fields.label: Kuwait Agency Name (from visa)

fields.description: New post-contract checkpoint (2026-08-29), distinct from the Applicant's earlier registration-time FIT check and the later pre-departure Medical 2 check. UNFIT here cancels the whole Applicant + Placement (applicant_api.cancel_applicant), for every track/country alike. Gates Selected -> Processing (state_machine.medical_selected_gate).
fields.label: Medical Status
Examination Date
fields.description: Hidden 2026-09-23 (client #18): only the Medical 2 result is kept on screen; the date is still accepted and stored.
Within ~72h of the flight. Separate from the Applicant's earlier registration-time FIT check (Part A.2 Stage 8) and the Selected-stage check above — gates Ticketed -> Departed.
fields.label: Medical 2 Status

fields.description: Always ETB. The first non-zero value is recorded as one auto-Approved Expense (fee_type 'Ticket'); a later different value corrects that same row -- see placement_api.record_ticket_details. Corridor fees are recorded per clearance step, not here.
fields.label: Ticket Cost

fields.description: Set once record_ticket_details has recorded the ticket-cost Expense (the name predates 2026-09-23, when corridor fees moved to per-step recording). Later ticket_cost changes edit that row instead of adding one.
fields.label: Corridor Fees Logged
Legacy Lump-Sum Fees
fields.description: Set by patch stage_fees_setup: this placement's corridor fees were already recorded in the old combined ticketing entry, so per-step fees are never recorded for it.

Internal reschedules only (an airline/airport-caused one isn't billed to us). ETB; each Internal reschedule is recorded as its own auto-Approved Expense (fee_type 'Ticket (Internal Reschedule)') -- see placement_api.record_reschedule.
fields.label: Reschedule Cost

fields.description: Part A.1: Muayena commission is never a default rate — always set manually per case. Standard-track placements use the Contractor's default_commission_rates instead (Part D).
fields.label: Manual Commission Amount
Manual Commission Currency
fields.options:
SAR
KWD
USD
ETB
AED
QAR

fields.description: Part A.4: a replacement selected within the 3-month post-departure window is free — commission was already collected on the original placement. Set only via portal_api.select_candidate()'s free_replacement_for_complaint parameter.
fields.label: Free Replacement

fields.description: Stamped automatically the first time this Placement reaches Departed — the anchor for the 3-month free-replacement window (Part A.4), not the same as the record's modified timestamp, which can move for unrelated reasons afterward.
fields.label: Departed On
